run_spm_encode_pieces: run the spm_encode script to encode input text files as sentencepiece tokens using a model
run_spm_encode_ids: run the spm_encode script to encode input text files as sentencepiece token IDs using a model
run_spm_encode_with_length_filter: run the spm_encode script with min-len and max-len filters to encode only lines within token bounds
run_spm_encode_stdin: run the spm_encode script to encode text from stdin and write encoded output to stdout
run_spm_encode_multi_file: run the spm_encode script to encode multiple parallel input files and write to multiple output files
